v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Ante lucíferum génitus, * et ante sǽcula, Dóminus Salvátor noster hódie mundo appáruit.
text.en: The Lord our Saviour, * begotten before the day-star, and before the ages, is this day made manifest in the world.

text.la: Venit lumen tuum * Ierúsalem, et glória Dómini super te orta est, et ambulábunt gentes in lúmine tuo, allelúia.
text.en: O Jerusalem, * thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee, and the Gentiles shall walk in thy light. Alleluia.

text.la: Apértis thesáuris suis * obtulérunt Magi Dómino aurum, thus, et myrrham, allelúia.
text.en: When the wise men * had opened their treasures, they presented unto the Lord gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Alleluia.

text.la: Mária et flúmina * benedícite Dómino: hymnum dícite fontes Dómino, allelúia.
text.en: O ye seas and floods, * bless ye the Lord. O ye wells, bless ye the Lord. Alleluia.

text.la: Stella ista * sicut flamma corúscat, et Regem regum Deum demónstrat: Magi eam vidérunt, et magno Regi múnera obtulérunt.
text.en: This star shineth * as a flame of fire, and pointeth out God, the King of kings: the Wise Men beheld it, and offered gifts unto the great King.

text.la: Surge, illumináre Ierúsalem, quia venit lumen tuum, et glória Dómini super te orta est.
text.en: Arise, be enlightened, O Jerusalem: for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

text.la: Hódie * cælésti Sponso iuncta est Ecclésia, quóniam in Iordáne lavit Christus eius crímina: currunt cum munéribus Magi ad regáles núptias, et ex aqua facto vino lætántur convívæ, allelúia.
text.en: This day is the Church joined unto the Heavenly Bridegroom, * since Christ hath washed away her sins in Jordan; the wise men hasten with gifts to the marriage supper of the King; and they that sit at meat together make merry with water turned into wine. Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui hodiérna die Unigénitum tuum géntibus stella duce revelásti: concéde propítius; ut qui iam te ex fide cognóvimus, usque ad contemplándam spéciem tuæ celsitúdinis perducámur.
text.en: O God, Who by the leading of a star didst, as on this day, manifest thine Only-begotten Son to the Gentiles, mercifully grant that we, which know thee now by faith, may after this life have the fruition of thy glorious Godhead:
